rules.name: cash-refresh-11b-ssv-writer-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE security_id = :securityId ORDER BY value_date

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id = :securityId ORDER BY value_date

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id = :securityId ORDER BY value_date

SELECT business_unit, value_date, created_by, updated_by, min(created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_updated, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' GROUP BY business_unit, value_date, created_by, updated_by ORDER BY business_unit, value_date

SELECT business_unit, value_date, created_by, updated_by, min(created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_updated, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' GROUP BY business_unit, value_date, created_by, updated_by ORDER BY business_unit, value_date
